name: Proof of Code
tagline: Records a coder's edits in real time so organisers can replay them and flag suspicious pastes.

awards: Davis Prize for Human Ingenuity in Computing - Alumni Prize

problem: Organisers cannot tell whether hackathon code was written by AI.
solution: A VS Code extension streams edits to a server; large sudden additions are flagged and histories can be replayed.
demo_moment: Team-described: replay a session and see a flagged paste.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Davis Prize for Human Ingenuity in Computing - Alumni Prize” among 223 submissions.
Answers a prize asking for AI-use detection tools.

lessons: Provenance by recording beats detection by guessing.
